errors.note: Accepted: world.c holds one byte that is not UTF-8, 0x99 (TRADE MARK SIGN in cp1252), inside a block comment at line 127, and the game compiles the file. The validator reads sources as UTF-8 only, so it reports the file instead of judging it.

Accepted: 'Mission mission' is declared at input.c:272 under '#ifdef PLATFORM_PS4' (:266) and at :282 under '#ifdef PLATFORM_XBOX' (:278), in two consecutive blocks; the detector treats only the arms of one #ifdef/#else as exclusive. Neither block compiles in a PC build.
Accepted: vanilla is lax about checking read returns. That does not make a truncated save harmless in a mod, so the rule stays live and these six are allowed by name.

tree.dayz_build_note: Build of the measured tree: DayZ 1.30.164289 stable (DayZDiag_x64.exe file version 1.30.164.289, product version 1.30.164289.70), tree digest fd826b4016910c5ca99046158d6e07aea79b4e52722b5ad20b36ffed8e527a1e. sources/source-map.json declares the build the pack is anchored on, which can be older. Identity of the control tree is the digest; set this deliberately when re-baselining after a patch.
tree.digest_scope: sha256 over (posix relpath, sha256 of contents) of every file the validator discovers under the vanilla root, in walk order. Not comparable to the vanilla_index digest, which covers .c only.

what_this_is: Expected findings of dayz-script-validator over Bohemia's vanilla script tree. The tree compiles and ships, so any finding on it is a false positive by construction: this file is the allowlist of the ones already triaged, each with the reason it is tolerated. A finding that is NOT here fails the control.
